_comment: ORDER-AUGMENTED control. Identical to stage0-4block except that the stage
execution order is resampled every training step. This is the CAUSAL test
- If an order-augmented model still collapses under eval-time reversal,
order-dependence is structural and the trained-order collapse proves
- If it does NOT collapse, order-dependence was learned and is
avoidable, which is the claim the diagnostic is supposed to make.
Reading it against configs/stage0-4block.json (same data, same steps, only
the order augmentation differs) isolates the intervention.
CAVEAT: this run's training loss is NOT comparable to the ordered run's.
It is solving a different, permutation-robust function. Compare held-out
accuracy and the profile evidence, not loss.
The profile evidence (entropy / max-deviation / mean off-diagonal
correlation) is the reading that needs no control at all, so it works on
the weights-only rungs where the random-weight control sits at chance.
